ground_truth.node_text: Start

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please complete the following structural checks. First, inspect the gripper body for any cracks, dents, or deformation at the jaw mounting faces. Then check the actuator housing for impact damage or distortion. Finally, inspect the jaw slide channel for scoring or material loss.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the gripper body for cracks, dents, or deformation at jaw mounting faces. 2. Check the actuator housing for impact damage or distortion. 3. Inspect the jaw slide channel for scoring or material loss.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All structural checks complete. The gripper body, actuator housing, and jaw slide channel have been inspected.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the gripper body for cracks, dents, or deformation at jaw mounting faces. 2. Check the actuator housing for impact damage or distortion. 3. Inspect the jaw slide channel for scoring or material loss.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is there any structural damage present on the gripper body?

ground_truth.node_text: Structural damage present on gripper body?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No structural damage detected. All surfaces appear intact with no visible cracks, dents, or deformation.

ground_truth.node_text: Structural damage present on gripper body?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the jaw insert wear within tolerance?

ground_truth.node_text: Jaw insert wear within tolerance?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the jaw insert measurements are within the serviceable thickness range specified in the service specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Jaw insert wear within tolerance?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the gripping force within the rated range?

ground_truth.node_text: Gripping force within rated range?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the force readings are below the minimum specification at both fifty and one hundred percent programmed pressure.

ground_truth.node_text: Gripping force within rated range?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please adjust the gripper actuator pressure to the rated value.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust gripper actuator pressure to rated value

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Actuator pressure has been adjusted to the rated value per specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust gripper actuator pressure to rated value

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please reverify the gripping force after the pressure adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify gripping force after pressure adjustment

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The gripping force now reads within the acceptable range at both test pressures.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify gripping force after pressure adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the jaw alignment within positional tolerance?

ground_truth.node_text: Jaw alignment within positional tolerance?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all three measurement points are within the permitted positional tolerance stated in the qualification record.

ground_truth.node_text: Jaw alignment within positional tolerance?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the lubrication level and condition adequate?

ground_truth.node_text: Lubrication level and condition adequate?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the pivot pins show signs of dry running and need fresh lubricant applied.

ground_truth.node_text: Lubrication level and condition adequate?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please apply lubricant to the pivot pins per the lubrication chart.

ground_truth.node_text: Apply lubricant to pivot pins per lubrication chart

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Lubricant applied to all pivot pins and distributed through three full cycles. Excess has been wiped from contact surfaces.

ground_truth.node_text: Apply lubricant to pivot pins per lubrication chart

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please log this maintenance activity and update the maintenance management system service record.

ground_truth.node_text: Log maintenance and update maintenance management system service record

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Maintenance has been logged and the service record updated in the system.

ground_truth.node_text: Log maintenance and update maintenance management system service record

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Procedure complete. The gripper fixture has passed all diagnostic checks and is ready to return to service.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Understood, returning the fixture to production.
